injuries.t: LeBron James OUT (low back/sciatica), downgraded from questionable. Embiid likely sits one game of back-to-back. Barlow, Fall, Hukporti out; Wade Q.
Saka, Saliba, Tzolis out
Grealish (ill), Branthwaite (concussion protocol) out
Pep Chavarria out; Malo Gusto returns
QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson OUT (high left ankle sprain), third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts vs Bengals. LB Tavius Robinson (IR) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also out.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).
DeVonta Smith, Nolan Smith, Wicks out Monday vs Cowboys; Barkley questionable.
S Jevon Holland (concussion) and TE Theo Johnson (neck) downgraded to OUT at Texans; Greg Newsome II out; Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
Bulls C Nic Claxton out (hamstring); Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa out (ankle), third straight game.
Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones, Strawther out; Alpha Diallo questionable vs Pelicans.

vs Suns: Curry (knee management), Draymond Green (back), Podziemski (back), Horford (back) out; Butler, Moody, Porzingis also out. Suns: Ighodaro out. Supports Suns -6.5 leg; line likely already adjusted.
C Jalen Duren OUT (right hamstring) at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle). Paul Reed expected to start.
Zach Edey OUT (ankle management, back-to-back) at Kings; Cedric Coward questionable (wrist).
S Jevon Holland, TE Theo Johnson, CB Greg Newsome II out at Texans; LB Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out Monday vs Cowboys.
Courtois (flu) out for El Clásico; Lunin starts in goal. Vinícius Jr suspended.
WR Puka Nacua questionable (calf), will test pregame; Davante Adams out (hamstring); CB Trent McDuffie Q, LB Nate Landman out. Recheck Rams -8.5 before kickoff.
RB Breece Hall questionable/unlikely (quad) vs Dolphins; Braelon Allen expected to lead.
Lamar Jackson confirmed OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts.
Devin Carter - Out: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

Egor Demin - Day-To-Day: Demin (leg) won't return to Tuesday's game against Boston, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports. He finished with two points (1-3 FG, 0-2 3Pt), one rebound, two assists and one steal over 10 minutes.
Tyler Bilodeau - Out: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.
Isaiah Joe - Out: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Cameron Carr - Out: The Lakers recalled Carr (oblique) from the G League's Coachella Valley Lakers on Tuesday, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Portland.
Jose Alvarado - Out: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.
Chris Youngblood - Out: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

conditions.name: v2 higher avg CLV vs FanDuel
v2 higher avg CLV vs Pinnacle
At least 30 top picks graded (each model)

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).
